title: metadata-protocol: registry-question.ts header says the record-currency follow door is asked by nothing else, which the batch writers (#32474) and package registration (#32483) both falsify
body:
domain:server#8 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwqTK71kjQzHae8T5J

Blocked-by: #32927
Source: contract review of PR #32927 (record 6839446638), boundary flag "stale clause" and nit N3.

## Problem

1. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts` line 14 describes the follow door as one "which nothing else asks". Since #32474 the batch writers ask it, and once PR #32927 lands the registry's run end asks it for every installed or reloaded package. Prose only, but it misleads the next reader about who enforces the record-currency follow pair.
2. (N3) A follow amount contributed by an `extend` layer is judged by neither asker (the door's `partial` rule, unchanged from `main`): a package extending a parent or child with a following amount can register a pair the door never sees. Measure whether this is reachable from an install, and either pin it as intended (with the reason) or close it.

## Do

- Item 1: correct the header to name every asker (single save/publish, batch writers, registration run end). Prose only, `Clause-②: no`.
- Item 2: measure first; if it is a real gap, it is a narrowing and owes its own contract review and changeset.
